version.changelog: Declare required credential in SKILL.md metadata (primaryEnv + requires.env). Fixes registry showing no required env vars.

llm.summary: This skill does what it says: it sends user-provided PDFs to PDFAPIHub to convert them into CSV files.

dimensions.detail: External network transmission and an API key are necessary for the hosted conversion workflow, but users should treat uploaded PDFs as shared with a third-party service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown and JSON artifacts, with no executable scripts, dependency installation, or local setup behavior beyond requiring a PDFAPIHUB_API_KEY environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill defines narrow use cases, required inputs, endpoint, authentication header, and output options for PDF-to-CSV conversion; no hidden role changes or prompt-injection behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, local indexing, credential-store access, or mutation of agent behavior was present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The cloud PDF-to-CSV conversion capability is coherent with the stated purpose, and the artifacts repeatedly disclose that PDFs are uploaded to PDFAPIHub for processing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable sending PDFs and a PDFAPIHub API key to a hosted third-party conversion service. Do not process confidential documents unless PDFAPIHub's retention and privacy terms are acceptable for your use case.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: The external POST to pdfapihub.com is real, but it is the disclosed core function of the skill rather than hidden exfiltration.
[SQP-1] expected: The example request is narrowly tied to the documented PDF-to-CSV endpoint, and the surrounding SKILL.md and skill.json provide the missing purpose and parameter context.
